name: Spectral Door
slug: A mysterious spectral door resembling Gerk's shield form
description: A giant spectral, shining door of unexplained nature that appears hovering near Gerk. It is closed, majestic, and strongly resembles Gerk's door-shaped shield form. The door has no visible opening or contents, and its exact nature, purpose, and connection to the Doorman event remain unknown.

log.summary: A giant spectral door appeared near Gerk after the magical discharge and later aboard the boat. Sylan investigated it and discovered that Gerk was physically standing beside it rather than being part of the door itself. The door appears intangible or otherwise unusual, but its purpose and connection to the Doorman event remain unexplained.
